learnings.description: What the item taught, new or updated. Empty when it taught nothing worth keeping.

updates.description: The ID of the existing learning this refines (L-0017), or "" for a new one.

kind.description: rule: a finding that turned out right. false-positive: what not to flag, and why. map: what a module does. decision: the human's ruling on an escalation.

scope.description: Globs of the repo paths it applies to, as narrow as is true (apps/api/src/webhooks/**). [] only when it applies anywhere.

lens.description: The review lens it informs, or "".

source.description: Where it came from: H-0042/F1 for a finding, H-0042 for the item.

title.description: One sentence: the learning itself, specific and checkable.

body.description: Two to five sentences: when it applies, why, and how to tell. No code copied from the repo.

retire.description: IDs of existing learnings this item shows are wrong or obsolete.
